body:
_Migrated from issue #1181, filed 2026-07-27._

Split out of #1180.

`POST /api/v1/auth/magic-link/start` returns `403 magic_link_disabled` when the admin toggle `config_remote_login` is off (`default=False`, `cps/config_sql.py:101`). Nothing asserts that automatically.

Both directions matter and neither is covered today:
- **enabled** → 200 with `verify_url` (now covered by `login-redirect.spec.ts:68`, once #1180 seeds the toggle)
- **disabled** → 403, and the SPA login screen should not offer the magic-link affordance

#1180 verified the disabled path by hand against a live container, but hand-verification does not survive a refactor.

The e2e suite now runs with the toggle **on** for the whole job, so this cannot simply be another Playwright spec in the same run — flipping the toggle mid-suite would make spec order load-bearing, which is its own trap. Better shapes: an API-level test that drives the endpoint with the flag forced off, or a separate short job with its own container.

Found while root-causing why the SPA e2e gate was red on every branch.
title: Magic-link disabled path (403) has no automated coverage
